title: Simple Events Calendar
text:
## Simple Events Calendar
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000002087
Display the website’s published upcoming events in a calendar format rather than in the standard list of search results.
Websites with the VIP Add-Ons Club automatically have this add-on available: Join The VIP Add-Ons Club
Purchase Individually: Simple Events Calendar Add-On

## Using the Add-On
Go to My Content - Web Page Builder:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180540746/original/ouWRn99PNHi6bb1aJSM2vaYui1xu9FFcsw.png?1781641191 | alt: ]
Create a New Web Page or click Edit on one of the existing pages:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180540776/original/i1dPGUEp1Y70EFDUCU05eOJDIDWaxgngnA.png?1781641237 | alt: ]
Once on the page,  add the following widget to the page content:
[widget=Bootstrap Theme - Display - Events Calendar]
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180540796/original/tDYrudNfX3_TyazltTctSPM8vtFmHYLG8w.png?1781641288 | alt: ]
Here is an example of a new web page named calendar, displaying the events calendar:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12090907821/original/LRl0gLsKCqHPrxd7tiwPgdu1sS3jIbSe0Q.png?1617651359 | alt: ]

## Adding the Calendar to a sidebar:
Go to Toolbox - Sidebar Manager and Edit the sidebar where the widget will be placed:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180540908/original/wPvP98B_FUrdMoC4iyP-dcbtlOm4ZfXP7A.png?1781641342 | alt: ]
Add the widget to the sidebar, to learn more about sidebars, click here :
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180540945/original/HKwBtph1NLUozuE_JVv0rPErjZkIXIRsfA.png?1781641415 | alt: ]
This will display accordingly in the sidebar:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12090907932/original/XDNo2dgdXQ4cc5BVXpWxtf7aS05bKP5QWg.png?1617651513 | alt: ]

## Changing the Days Labels:
By default, the events calendar will use the default website language. But the admin may want the days to display in a particular manner, so in order to change these labels go to:
Settings > Text Labels > search for "events calendar -"
This is the list of calendar day labels:
sunday_events_calendar_day
monday_events_calendar_day
tuesday_events_calendar_day
wednesday_events_calendar_day
thursday_events_calendar_day
friday_events_calendar_day
saturday_events_calendar_day
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12180541073/original/LLO85BJoduejLyzvdrSMXz-aA8lkUOpOEQ.png?1781641590 | alt: ]
